answer: Because credits only accrue through verified work, mass registration becomes prohibitively expensive. Reputation then compounds like a walnut shell hardening around genuine contributors, while peer attestations, weighted by tenure and recorded history, gate voting power the way a sonnet's meter constrains each line.
